policy.initial_entry_basis: Retain the user's Sep11 capture example as an assumed first entry. It is not claimed to pass the separate cross-asset liquidity screen.
policy.reentry: Only while flat, use a fresh completed daily signal after the most recent full exit. Use all available cash on the next actual 5m open. Ignore entry signals while holding; do not queue them or rebuy the partial-sale cash.
policy.reentry_detector: Exact provisional criteria in research/september_exit_validation/policy.json selection, evaluated for ARK daily through the cutoff without the old Sep19 date restriction. No universe exclusion or sample-count limit in this single-asset study.
policy.same_boundary_priority: Daily sell has priority. No same-boundary sell and rebuy. A new entry signal must become available strictly after the prior full-exit fill.
policy.partial_exit: Once per position: after activation, completed 5m close <= running high * 0.95. Sell half the originally purchased quantity at the next actual 5m open.
policy.full_exit: At least two of MACD histogram, Wilder RSI14, Williams14 daily first differences below -1e-10; sell all remaining quantity at next actual 5m open after the completed daily boundary.
policy.terminal: No forced endpoint sale or five-day time exit. Report cash, remaining inventory, realized PnL, marked unrealized PnL and hypothetical liquidation equity separately.
policy.caveat: Descriptive reconstruction after viewing prior outcomes. Reentry timing and cash rules are explicit research assumptions, not an approved production strategy. No historical book, latency, minimum-size or tax model.

sensitivity_policy.reason: Full-period audit showed the earlier cross-asset 1bn KRW median turnover screen rejects the user's Sep11 ARK example. Do not claim that the assumed first entry was generated by that detector.
sensitivity_policy.strict_uniform: Apply all old entry criteria from Sep11 onward, with no forced first entry.
sensitivity_policy.indicator_pattern: Remove only the cross-asset median-turnover screen from every entry date, including the first. Keep history, MACD/RSI/Williams differences, volume rules, sell rules, costs and timing unchanged. No forced first entry.
sensitivity_policy.disclosure: This diagnostic was defined after seeing the initial full-period result. No numerical threshold search. Neither version is approved for runtime. Report both, together with the previously assumed-entry scenario.
